panel.duiding.title: Interpretation
panel.duiding.empty: No interpretation available yet for this cluster.
panel.epicurve.title: Epidemic curve
panel.epicurve.note: The shaded zone covers the last {days_phrase}: the empirical reporting delay from the reporting triangle. Cases with a sample date in this window are not yet fully reported. A falling tail here is not a decline.
panel.trend.title: Multi-year trend
panel.trend.note: Observed counts against the expectation and the signal threshold from farringtonFlexible. Meant to show whether the current rise falls within the normal seasonal pattern.
panel.trend.unavailable: No trend data available yet; this stream has insufficient baseline history for farringtonFlexible.
panel.denominator.title: Denominator and positivity
panel.denominator.note: The commonest cause of a false signal is rising test volume, not rising incidence. If the bars rise but the line stays flat, the increase is a denominator effect.
panel.denominator.unavailable: No positivity data available for this pathogen. This is optional; not every laboratory method can report negatives.
panel.demography.title: Age and sex
panel.demography.note: A shift in the affected age group relative to the historical baseline is often more informative than the count itself.
panel.geo.title: Geographic spread
panel.geo.unit: The app shows a PC4 choropleth here via certegis.
panel.resistance.title: Phenotypic resistance profile
panel.resistance.note: Not a substitute for typing, but a shared profile makes a common source more plausible and can prompt sending isolates for WGS.
panel.resistance.unavailable: No resistance data linked to cases in this system yet.

duiding.fragment.magnitude.rare_trigger: {obs_phrase} reported within this cluster. No statistical signal threshold applies to this pathogen: detection comes from the curated trigger list, which picks up every reported case regardless of baseline.
duiding.fragment.magnitude.high_ratio: {obs_phrase} against an expectation of {expected}: a ratio of {ratio}.
duiding.fragment.magnitude.moderate_rati: {obs_phrase} against an expectation of {expected}, a ratio of {ratio}, a moderate excess over baseline.
duiding.fragment.concentration.high: {dominant_n} of the {total_n} cases ({dominant_share_pct}%) come from {dominant_label}, pointing to strong place-based clustering.
duiding.fragment.concentration.moderate: {dominant_n} of the {total_n} cases ({dominant_share_pct}%) come from {dominant_label}, a moderate concentration.
duiding.fragment.concentration.diffuse: Cases are spread across several locations; the largest, {dominant_label}, accounts for only {dominant_share_pct}% of the cluster.
duiding.fragment.denominator.rising_volu: Test volume rose from {test_first} to {test_last} tests per week, while positivity stayed nearly flat ({positivity_first_pct}% to {positivity_last_pct}%). Part of the rise is therefore attributable to test volume, not incidence.
duiding.fragment.denominator.rising_posi: Positivity rose from {positivity_first_pct}% to {positivity_last_pct}% at a comparable test volume. The rise is therefore not attributable to test volume.
duiding.fragment.denominator.stable: Test volume and positivity are stable over the shown period ({positivity_first_pct}% to {positivity_last_pct}%).
duiding.fragment.demography.shifted: The age distribution has shifted towards the {dominant_band} group, against a baseline of {baseline_band}.
duiding.fragment.completeness.warning: Note: the last {incomplete_days_phrase} are incomplete due to reporting delay. The true count is likely higher.
duiding.fragment.recommendation.rare_tri: This is a pathogen on the curated trigger list; assess promptly and check the statutory notification duty.
duiding.fragment.recommendation.high_pri: The combination of size and concentration warrants considering classification as a (possible) epidemic and coordination with infection prevention or public health.
duiding.fragment.recommendation.moderate: Monitor this cluster's development; a classification of cluster without epidemic may be appropriate as long as no further signs of spread emerge.
duiding.fragment.recommendation.default: Assess this cluster on the basis of the data above; there is not yet sufficient evidence for urgent follow-up.
